existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decreased plasma PGF2alpha concentration is the same event as 'Reduced, Prostaglandin F2alpha concentration, plasma' (plasma context), so it fits this PGF2alpha plasma vs ovary group.
Decreased T3 in tissues is a decreased thyroid hormone event in a tissue context, matching the serum/brain thyroid hormone decrease group.

new_groups.rationale: Increased thyroid hormone (T3 in tissues vs T4 in serum) in different compartments.
T3 in tissues decreased vs increased, same endpoint in opposite directions.
Increased prolactin exposure vs increased prolactin secretion, related prolactin increase events with different specifics.
